native_frame_join: Each trace row's native_frame must match the pinned FrameMap row's carla_frame. Both must use the same consecutive CARLA frame identity; video_frame must run from 0 through 599 and time_s must equal video_frame / 20. A duplicate native_frame key in the map must agree.
camera_decode: All four camera streams must fully decode as 600 frames at 20 Hz with positive dimensions.
driver_reference_scope: Retain the raw driver-reference pixels and camera pose metadata for independent review. A simulator camera without a visible, behaviorally modeled driver cannot establish actual driver attention.
episode_context: CARLA map identity and road OpenDRIVE source
original trace and per-frame capture evidence
signal and roadway context if present
all camera extrinsics and active field of view
source hashes and Native process exit
